jsch validate --schema schema.json --output verbose good.json
# /properties annotates with the list of matched keys.
stdout '"keywordLocation":"/properties"'
stdout '"annotation":\["[ab]","[ab]"\]'
# /title surfaces as an annotation in verbose output.
stdout '"keywordLocation":"/title"'
stdout '"annotation":"Sample"'

-- schema.json --
{
  "title": "Sample",
  "properties": {
    "a": { "type": "string" },
    "b": { "type": "integer" }
  }
}
-- good.json --
{"a":"x","b":1}
